title: Fake Mental Health Bot
scenario: A bot says it offers confidential support but asks for name, school, and secrets.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.C: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Fake Mental Health Bot: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Use trusted support channels; do not give private details to unknown bots.
